name: Mortain
locality: Manche; canton of Mortain; arrondissement of Avranches
text: Mortain (French pronunciation: [mɔʁtɛ̃]) is a former commune in the Manche department in Normandy in north-western France. On 1 January 2016, it was merged into the new commune of Mortain-Bocage.

depictions.name: Mortain
depictions.text: Mortain is a map in Hell Let Loose. This map is based on the siege of Mortain, which had men of the 30th Infantry division (120th regiment) stranded in the town of Mortain, as part of Operation Luttich. Operation Luttich was an operation meant to drive back the allied invasion at Normandy.
